'''2007 Oklahoma State Championship Chris Perry DS Cloud City: Port Town District''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Perry]] at [[2007 Oklahoma State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Force Drain Refineries
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
